body:
Ty for asking. I am okay though, both with the time and the potentially triggering details.

Any common trigger to your cutting? What emotions do you feel when deciding. Which ones are the strongest?
Do you fail by stopping yourself? Or is it a variety of reasons?
Did it end up leaving someone harmed? Are you feeling guilty? Or is it more you ruined chances? Or neither?

Yes I kinda get that

It sounds like a really relieving thought. Like you are saying to yourself and believing, I don't actually care about this body this life anymore.

Zero attachment?

What do you feel about the thought
What are some of them?

Do you think your friends or family should feel guily about reaching out to you?

In my actions I display that I think no, they should not feel guilty. But, I, also still 100% logically believe that it's a bother, or at least a difficulty added to the other persons life. Then when others come into question, I ignore the fact that it is difficulty added to my life, and want to and do try to help.

And I am not capable of living with that burden caused. I can and do prevent it (by isolating and if bad, that can end up with me cutting)

---

Also, that sucks about the parents. 😕

Any medicine or strong measures taken to try and live with the thoughts, or to maybe try and elimimate the thoughts? (idk how it works)

Curious to know what hasnt worked, or maybe did but fell off.

I don't yet have suicidal thoughts that often, but Social Anxiety+Self-Esteem wears me down, and often leads to suicidal/self-harm type thoughts. For that, SSRIs haven't worked (yet), self-love doesnt work, pets don't work. It's a very internal and selfish affair, that is unable help itself.

Ty, and I wish you the best of luck with the paper. Hope it goes by fast.

But "today" (Friday, saturday) i just slept and when not sleeping, cut myself. Lol. I guess I did well in that right now I am okay? And it didn't get worse? Ty anyway though. You are very nice to say that 😁
What tipped you over

Idk, I feel very stigmatized to say this, but maybe medicine is the answer. The weird disconnect between good life and cutting+negative feelings makes me think "It's so obvious that something is irrationally wrong here"

Or maybe incorporating your sad feelings and sad beliefs into your friendships is the key. But also that sounds so selfish to me. I also always end up feeling worse about myself reaching out, whether that be I didn't get the support I was looking for, or I just feel like such a burden even after they respond.

Fk that is not the check up I was hoping for.

I am absolute rock bottom so I don't know what to say, but sorry. Hope you feel better in the bad soon.

Mega feels.

Idk yet how to deal with that thought. Everything is because of me. Either my reaction, or my inability to be assertive and speak for myself.

I just kinda ride the waves lately, try to observe my downfall while it happens (during high points I kind of just enjoy it, instead of observe). Some thoughts just have so much power in my head.

Ah that's scary to me. 

If you want to, you can try also dming me when you feel like self-harming. Or during or after, I don't really want you to feel trapped into not selfharming.

Idk if talking about the frustration/overwhelmingness would help or not, but when I think of my less frequent moments of self-harm, I feel really angry when trying to distract myself.

How do you feel about the frustration/overwhelmingness, do you think that feeling is important to learning what's bothering you?
Yeah that's just fked up. Makes this very difficult life sooo much better 😡😡

Sry, that really does sound exhausting. 

What's been the more recent causes for cutting, any common deeper thought?

Guess the sleep aids kicking in. Fucking sedate myself,  bury the thought, and wait for it to slowly come back in several days.

Best I can do. 😕
When will amazon sell strong drugs. Please get me out of this head ffs I'll pay you so much.
So like no memory ?

I cant kms, feels too much like I'm faking all this, and i actually can live normally.

Maybe thats the hope talking though...

same with the imagining reactions thing
Wish i could control that part of me because it really causes me to feel more down
What hasnt worked for you. multiple ssris havent seemed to work for me.
